    The prime-field model C⁽²⁾ of k(Γ_A) (Section 10) #

    "The all-one meshes of Section 7 define a graded category C⁽²⁾ with k ⊗_{𝔽₂} C⁽²⁾ = C. […] Evaluation identifies C⁽²⁾ with their full Hom category, since it does so after the faithful field extension to k. The same extension commutes with graded Ext […]. Lemma 6.3 therefore gives Ext^n_{A⁽²⁾}(M_i⁽²⁾, M_j⁽²⁾)_d = 0 (n ≥ 1, d ≥ 0)."

    For char k = 2: the all-one scalar mesh category C⁽²⁾ = C(Γ_A, 1) over 𝔽₂ (prime2), the gauge of Lemma 4.4 (arGauge), the form functor to k(Γ_A) with equal Hom dimensions, and the mesh data of C⁽²⁾ (primeMeshData) obtained by descent of the exact meshes of k(Γ_A) (arMeshExact, Proposition 2.6), with injective labels (primeInjData) and degree-one arrows. Lemma 6.3 then holds for C⁽²⁾ (primeExtVanish): the same proof, for the descended mesh data, replaces the base change of Ext.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
